# Business card & vCard maker

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/business-card/

Design a simple business card from your own contact information and export a PNG, SVG or downloadable vCard contact file.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Create a card with your name, role, email and website, then export the matching VCF file.

## Limits and checks

A vCard contains the contact details you enter. Review each field before sharing; no email is sent and no address book is modified by this tool.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
